hero.title: More than just a map It's the future of Pi eCommerce

hackathonWinner.title: Map of Pi—2024 Pi Commerce Hackathon Winner!
hackathonWinner.description: Map of Pi stood out for its intuitive user interface (UI), centering around a map where users can find local Pi businesses. Merchants are already able to go through the flow of adding their business to the map, and the Map of Pi team is adding functionality such as QR codes, menu items, and more.

hackathonWinner.feature2: Pi Authentication and Pi Payments integrations

escrowPi.title: Not just secure payments—It's trust built into Pi eCommerce
escrowPi.subtitle: EscrowPi is a next-generation utility in the Pi Network ecosystem
escrowPi.description: Designed to make transactions safer, smoother, and more reliable for both buyers and sellers, it acts as a neutral and automated escrow layer that only releases Pi when both sides confirm the transaction. Integrated through the Pi Browser, EscrowPi strengthens real-world commerce by reducing risk and removing the need for manual oversight—bringing confidence and fairness to every Pi exchange.

team.title: The Team
team.subtitle: Meet the global volunteer team building Map of Pi

ourBeginning.title: Our beginning
ourBeginning.subtitle: Where it all started
ourBeginning.description: The Map of Pi team began its journey during the 2024 Pi Commerce Hackathon, where a group of passionate developers and visionaries came together with a shared mission: to make Pi practical, spendable, and useful in everyday life. Through collaboration, innovation, and a clear focus on utility, Map of Pi quickly stood out among the competition.

ourDrive.title: Our drive
ourDrive.subtitle: What keeps us going
ourDrive.description: After winning the Hackathon, our team gained valuable support and resources from the Pi Core Team, which strengthened our foundation and validated the importance of building real-world Pi commerce solutions.
ourDrive.description2: Today, we continue to grow Map of Pi as a team of pro bono volunteers, united by our passion for the future of the Pi Ecosystem and the role that Pi eCommerce can play in global adoption. Our dedication is not driven by profit, but by the belief that Pi has the power to reshape how people connect, trade, and thrive.

ourVision.title: Our vision—
ourVision.subtitle: Where we're headed
ourVision.description: Looking ahead, we are preparing to evolve into an equity- and contribution-based system that rewards commitment and creativity, ensuring that every team member shares in the future success of the project. With this foundation, our long-term vision is to scale Map of Pi into a global company and brand, supporting millions of Pioneers and merchants worldwide.

ourOrganization.title: Our organization—
ourOrganization.subtitle: Meet the Map of Pi team

projectManager.title: Project Manager
projectManager.description: The Project Manager plays a key role in keeping the Map of Pi team organized and aligned. They oversee timelines, coordinate team efforts, and ensure that priorities are clearly defined. This role requires strong communication, leadership, and the ability to balance both short-term tasks and long-term goals.

ambassador.title: Ambassador
ambassador.description: Ambassadors represent Map of Pi within the global Pi community. They help spread awareness, onboard new users, and build relationships with merchants and Pioneers. Ambassadors act as the voice of the project on the ground, supporting adoption and trust.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.description: The Marketing team helps tell the story of Map of Pi to the world. From social media campaigns to branding and partnerships, marketing ensures that Pioneers and merchants understand the value of joining the ecosystem.

uxSolutions.title: UX/ Solutions
uxSolutions.description: The UX / Solutions role focuses on making Map of Pi intuitive and user-friendly. This team helps design the experience for both merchants and buyers, ensuring the app is accessible, functional, and enjoyable.

development.title: Development
development.description: The Development team builds and maintains the Map of Pi app and supporting infrastructure. They translate ideas and designs into features that Pioneers and merchants can use. Developers are responsible for scalability, performance, and security.

qualityAnalyst.title: Quality Analyst
qualityAnalyst.description: Quality Analysts play a key role in maintaining the reliability and trust of Map of Pi. They focus on testing new features, identifying issues, and providing clear feedback so that the app delivers a smooth and consistent experience for all Pioneers.

items.answer: You can reach our support team via email at contact@mapofpi.com or use the M.A.C. chatbot on mapofpi.com.

about.title: About Map of Pi
about.subtitle: We're building the future of Pi eCommerce on Pi Network. Our mission is to provide a secure, transparent, and innovative marketplace that connects Pi Network users with merchants worldwide.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description1: To create a production-grade marketplace that enables secure, fast, and low-cost transactions for the 55+ million users on Pi Network.
mission.description2: We believe in the power of blockchain technology to democratize commerce and provide financial services to everyone, everywhere.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description1: A world where Pi cryptocurrency is used in everyday commerce, enabling seamless global transactions and financial inclusion.
vision.description2: We envision Map of Pi becoming the standard marketplace for Pi Network, powering e-commerce, local commerce, and cross-border payments.
